statements:
CREATE TABLE background_executions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	subscription_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	task_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	inbox_message_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Originating QueueMessage ID for inbox auto-processing' DEFAULT '0', 
	trigger_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	trigger_reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	prompt TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	result_summary TEXT NOT NULL, 
	error_message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	retry_attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	completed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX ix_background_executions_created_at ON background_executions (created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_background_executions_inbox_message_id ON background_executions (inbox_message_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_background_executions_status ON background_executions (status)
CREATE INDEX ix_background_executions_subscription_id ON background_executions (subscription_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_background_executions_task_id ON background_executions (task_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_background_executions_user_id ON background_executions (user_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_bg_exec_subscription_created ON background_executions (subscription_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_bg_exec_user_created ON background_executions (user_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_bg_exec_user_status ON background_executions (user_id, status)

CREATE TABLE dingtalk_synced_nodes (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	dingtalk_node_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	doc_url VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL, 
	parent_node_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	node_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	raw_metadata JSON, 
	content_updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOL NOT NULL, 
	last_synced_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='DingTalk synced document nodes' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_dingtalk_nodes_user_node_source ON dingtalk_synced_nodes (user_id, dingtalk_node_id, source)
CREATE INDEX ix_dingtalk_nodes_user_parent ON dingtalk_synced_nodes (user_id, parent_node_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_dingtalk_synced_nodes_user_id ON dingtalk_synced_nodes (user_id)

CREATE TABLE kinds (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	namespace VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	json JSON NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX idx_kinds_name_kind_ns_active ON kinds (name, kind, namespace, is_active)
CREATE INDEX ix_kinds_id ON kinds (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_kinds_kind ON kinds (kind)
CREATE INDEX ix_kinds_kind_ns_active ON kinds (kind, namespace, is_active)
CREATE INDEX ix_kinds_user_kind_ns_active ON kinds (user_id, kind, namespace, is_active)

CREATE TABLE knowledge_artifacts (
	artifact_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Artifact UUID', 
	knowledge_base_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Owning knowledge base ID; 0 means unset' DEFAULT '0', 
	artifact_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Artifact type: briefing or mind_map' DEFAULT 'briefing', 
	title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Artifact title' DEFAULT '', 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Lifecycle status' DEFAULT 'queued', 
	task_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Related task ID; 0 means unset' DEFAULT '0', 
	assistant_subtask_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Related assistant subtask ID; 0 means unset' DEFAULT '0', 
	content TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Generated content; empty means unavailable', 
	source_document_ids JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'Source document ID list', 
	generation_config JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'Generation configuration', 
	error_message VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Failure message; empty means no error' DEFAULT '', 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Creator user ID; 0 means unset' DEFAULT '0', 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Generation attempt number' DEFAULT '1', 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Creation time' DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Last update time' DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (artifact_id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Knowledge base generated artifacts'
CREATE INDEX idx_knowledge_artifacts_kb_created ON knowledge_artifacts (knowledge_base_id, created_at, artifact_id)

CREATE TABLE knowledge_document_external_sources (
	document_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT '知识文档ID，关联knowledge_documents.id', 
	kind_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT '所属知识库ID，与知识文档的kind_id一致' DEFAULT '0', 
	external_provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '外部文档来源标识，如dingtalk；业务写入时不能为空' DEFAULT '', 
	external_resource_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '外部来源中的文档资源ID；业务写入时不能为空' DEFAULT '', 
	PRIMARY KEY (document_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_knowledge_documents_external UNIQUE (kind_id, external_provider, external_resource_id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='知识文档外部身份表，仅外部导入文档有记录'

CREATE TABLE knowledge_documents (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	kind_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attachment_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	file_extension VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	file_size BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	status ENUM('enabled','disabled') NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOL NOT NULL, 
	index_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	index_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	splitter_config JSON NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	source_config JSON NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', 
	folder_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	summary JSON, 
	chunks JSON, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Knowledge document table for file metadata' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_documents_attachment ON knowledge_documents (attachment_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_documents_folder_id ON knowledge_documents (folder_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_documents_id ON knowledge_documents (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_documents_kind_active_created ON knowledge_documents (kind_id, is_active, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_documents_kind_id ON knowledge_documents (kind_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_documents_user_id ON knowledge_documents (user_id)

CREATE TABLE knowledge_folders (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	kind_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	parent_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Knowledge base folder hierarchy for multi-level document organization' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_folders_id ON knowledge_folders (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_folders_kind_id ON knowledge_folders (kind_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_folders_parent ON knowledge_folders (kind_id, parent_id)

CREATE TABLE loop_item_executions (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	loop_item_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	cloud_project_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	executor_owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	agent_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	team_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Executing Wegent Team id; 0 means none' DEFAULT '0', 
	backend_task_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Managed backend task id; 0 means none' DEFAULT '0', 
	automation_run_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	execution_environment VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	execution_device_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	runtime_instance_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	assigner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', 
	priority_weight INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	queued_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
	completed_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
	lease_expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
	heartbeat_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
	attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', 
	previous_execution_id BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	execution_scope VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	observed_state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unconfirmed', 
	sync_state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', 
	claimed_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
	start_requested_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
	observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
	cancel_requested_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
	last_event_seq BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	termination_reason VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	retry_attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	max_retries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', 
	error_message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	execution_note VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	approval_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	approved_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	approved_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
	rejected_reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	runtime_device_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	runtime_task_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	execution_payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB
CREATE INDEX idx_exec_agent_status ON loop_item_executions (agent_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_exec_assigner_status ON loop_item_executions (assigner_user_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_exec_automation_run_id ON loop_item_executions (automation_run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_exec_device_status_order ON loop_item_executions (executor_owner_user_id, execution_device_id, execution_environment, status, priority_weight, queued_at, id)
CREATE INDEX idx_exec_item_status ON loop_item_executions (loop_item_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_exec_runtime_capacity ON loop_item_executions (executor_owner_user_id, runtime_instance_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_exec_scope_status ON loop_item_executions (execution_scope, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_exec_status_device ON loop_item_executions (status, execution_device_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_exec_team_status ON loop_item_executions (team_id, status)

CREATE TABLE marketplace_resources (
	kind_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Associated Kind resource ID', 
	owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Owner user ID copied from the associated Kind resource' DEFAULT '0', 
	resource_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Resource type: agent or skill' DEFAULT '', 
	recommendation_score SMALLINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Marketplace recommendation score from 0 to 100' DEFAULT '0', 
	install_count INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Cumulative first-time marketplace installations' DEFAULT '0', 
	published_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Initial marketplace publication time' DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Marketplace resource update time' DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (kind_id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB
CREATE INDEX idx_marketplace_resources_owner_type_updated ON marketplace_resources (owner_user_id, resource_type, updated_at, kind_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_marketplace_resources_type_installs ON marketplace_resources (resource_type, install_count, updated_at, kind_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_marketplace_resources_type_recommendation ON marketplace_resources (resource_type, recommendation_score, updated_at, kind_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_marketplace_resources_type_updated ON marketplace_resources (resource_type, updated_at, kind_id)

CREATE TABLE namespace (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(100), 
	owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	visibility VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	level VARCHAR(20), 
	is_active BOOL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Group (Namespace) table for resource organization' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX ix_namespace_id ON namespace (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_namespace_level ON namespace (level)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_namespace_name ON namespace (name)
CREATE INDEX ix_namespace_owner_user_id ON namespace (owner_user_id)

CREATE TABLE namespace_members (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	group_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	`role` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	invited_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT idx_group_user UNIQUE (group_name, user_id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Group membership table' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX ix_namespace_members_group_name ON namespace_members (group_name)
CREATE INDEX ix_namespace_members_id ON namespace_members (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_namespace_members_user_id ON namespace_members (user_id)

CREATE TABLE oauth_refresh_tokens (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Primary key' AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'SHA-256 hash of the refresh token' DEFAULT '', 
	token_prefix VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Non-secret token prefix for diagnostics' DEFAULT '', 
	family_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Refresh-token rotation family UUID' DEFAULT '', 
	client_kind_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'OAuth client kinds.id; 0 means unset' DEFAULT '0', 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Authorizing users.id; 0 means unset' DEFAULT '0', 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Expiration time' DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
	used_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Rotation time; epoch means unused' DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
	revoked_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Revocation time; epoch means active' DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 
	replaced_by_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Replacement token row id; 0 means unset' DEFAULT '0', 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Creation time' DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_oauth_refresh_tokens_token_hash UNIQUE (token_hash)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='OAuth refresh-token rotation and revocation records'
CREATE INDEX idx_oauth_refresh_tokens_client_kind_id ON oauth_refresh_tokens (client_kind_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_oauth_refresh_tokens_expires_at ON oauth_refresh_tokens (expires_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_oauth_refresh_tokens_family_id ON oauth_refresh_tokens (family_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_oauth_refresh_tokens_revoked_at ON oauth_refresh_tokens (revoked_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_oauth_refresh_tokens_user_id ON oauth_refresh_tokens (user_id)

CREATE TABLE plugin_device_installations (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Device installation primary key' AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	installed_kind_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'InstalledPlugin kinds.id' DEFAULT '0', 
	user_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Account owner user ID' DEFAULT '0', 
	device_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Target device identifier' DEFAULT '', 
	desired_release_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Desired release ID for the device' DEFAULT '0', 
	actual_release_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Actually installed release ID; 0 means none' DEFAULT '0', 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Install state: pending, installed, failed, etc.' DEFAULT 'pending', 
	error_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Last error code; empty means no error' DEFAULT '', 
	error_message VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Last error message; empty means no error' DEFAULT '', 
	attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Sync attempt count' DEFAULT '0', 
	last_sync_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Last sync time; epoch means never synced' DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000', 
	updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Last update time', 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_plugin_device_installation UNIQUE (installed_kind_id, device_id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Per-device materialization of installed plugin state'
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_device_device ON plugin_device_installations (device_id, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_device_user_state ON plugin_device_installations (user_id, state)

CREATE TABLE plugin_publication_checks (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	revision_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	stage VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	check_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	summary VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	execution_environment VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	job_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	acknowledgement_required BOOL NOT NULL, 
	acknowledged BOOL NOT NULL, 
	acknowledged_by_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_plugin_publication_check UNIQUE (revision_id, check_code)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Publication check evidence by stable code'
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_publication_check_status ON plugin_publication_checks (revision_id, status)

CREATE TABLE plugin_publication_events (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	revision_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	actor_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	actor_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	message VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	payload_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	external_event_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_plugin_publication_external_event UNIQUE (external_event_id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Append-only publication workflow audit events'
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_publication_event_timeline ON plugin_publication_events (revision_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE plugin_publication_idempotency (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	principal_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	principal_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	resource_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	request_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'processing', 
	response_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_plugin_publication_idempotency UNIQUE (principal_type, principal_id, operation, idempotency_key)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Durable publication workflow idempotency bindings'
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_publication_idempotency_status ON plugin_publication_idempotency (status, updated_at)

CREATE TABLE plugin_publication_requests (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	source_plugin_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	target_plugin_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	submitter_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	current_revision_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	current_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	aggregate_status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'uploading', 
	risk_level VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', 
	submitted_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000', 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Enterprise plugin publication request aggregates'
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_publication_request_owner ON plugin_publication_requests (submitter_user_id, aggregate_status, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_publication_request_source ON plugin_publication_requests (source_plugin_id, aggregate_status)

CREATE TABLE plugin_publication_revisions (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	request_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_release_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	requested_version VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	source_tree_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	storage_key VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	staging_storage_key VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	manifest_snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	package_entries_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	package_entry_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	capabilities_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	risk_declaration JSON NOT NULL, 
	release_notes VARCHAR(4096) NOT NULL, 
	test_notes VARCHAR(4096) NOT NULL, 
	source_updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000', 
	status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'uploading', 
	gitlab_project_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	gitlab_project_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	source_branch VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	merge_request_iid INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	merge_request_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	merge_request_status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	pipeline_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	pipeline_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	pipeline_status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	commit_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_by_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	completed_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000', 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_plugin_publication_revision UNIQUE (request_id, revision)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Immutable enterprise publication snapshots'
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_publication_revision_gitlab ON plugin_publication_revisions (gitlab_project_id, merge_request_iid)
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_publication_revision_status ON plugin_publication_revisions (status, updated_at)

CREATE TABLE plugin_release_idempotency (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(81) NOT NULL, 
	request_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	envelope_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'processing', 
	response_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	plugin_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	release_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	last_error VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_plugin_release_idempotency_key UNIQUE (idempotency_key)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Durable protected-pipeline release idempotency bindings'
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_release_idempotency_status ON plugin_release_idempotency (status, updated_at)

CREATE TABLE plugin_releases (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Release primary key' AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	plugin_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Owning plugin ID' DEFAULT '0', 
	version VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Semver release version' DEFAULT '', 
	manifest_json JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'Parsed package manifest JSON object; app writes {} when unset', 
	interface_json JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'Release interface metadata JSON object; app writes {} when unset', 
	release_notes VARCHAR(4096) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Release notes; empty means unset' DEFAULT '', 
	storage_key VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Object storage key for the package zip' DEFAULT '', 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Package content SHA-256 hex digest' DEFAULT '', 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Package size in bytes' DEFAULT '0', 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Release status: processing, ready, rejected, etc.' DEFAULT 'processing', 
	scan_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Security scan status: pending, passed, failed' DEFAULT 'pending', 
	scan_report_json JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'Security scan report JSON object; app writes {} when unset', 
	created_by_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Creator user ID; 0 means system / unset' DEFAULT '0', 
	publication_revision_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Publication revision that produced this release; 0 means none' DEFAULT '0', 
	source_commit_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Protected source commit SHA; empty means not GitLab-published' DEFAULT '', 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Creation time', 
	published_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Publish time; epoch means unpublished' DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000', 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_plugin_release_version UNIQUE (plugin_id, version)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Immutable marketplace plugin release packages'
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_releases_publication ON plugin_releases (publication_revision_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_releases_sha256 ON plugin_releases (sha256)
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_releases_status ON plugin_releases (plugin_id, status, published_at)

CREATE TABLE plugin_submissions (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Submission primary key' AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	plugin_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Target plugin ID' DEFAULT '0', 
	release_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Submitted release ID' DEFAULT '0', 
	submitter_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Submitter user ID' DEFAULT '0', 
	purpose VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Submission purpose' DEFAULT 'marketplace_publish', 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Review status: uploading, pending, approved, rejected' DEFAULT 'uploading', 
	reviewer_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Reviewer user ID; 0 means not reviewed' DEFAULT '0', 
	review_note VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Reviewer note; empty means unset' DEFAULT '', 
	submitted_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Submission time',

)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Persistent Wework inbox notifications'
CREATE INDEX idx_wework_notifications_inbox ON wework_notifications (user_id, created_at, id)

CREATE TABLE wework_transcript_archives (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Wework transcript archive primary key' AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	transcript_db_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Owning transcript ID; logical reference without database foreign key' DEFAULT '0', 
	from_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'First turn sequence contained in the archive' DEFAULT '0', 
	to_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Last turn sequence contained in the archive' DEFAULT '0', 
	storage_key VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Immutable object-storage key for the compressed archive' DEFAULT '', 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'SHA-256 digest of the compressed archive' DEFAULT '', 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Compressed archive size in bytes' DEFAULT '0', 
	format VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Archive serialization and compression format' DEFAULT 'jsonl.zst', 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Creation time' DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_wework_transcript_archive_range UNIQUE (transcript_db_id, from_sequence, to_sequence)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Immutable archived Wework transcript segments'
CREATE INDEX idx_wework_transcript_archive_range ON wework_transcript_archives (transcript_db_id, from_sequence)

CREATE TABLE wework_transcript_turns (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Wework transcript turn primary key' AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	transcript_db_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Owning transcript ID; logical reference without database foreign key' DEFAULT '0', 
	sequence BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Monotonic turn sequence within the transcript' DEFAULT '0', 
	turn_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Device-independent finalized turn identity' DEFAULT '', 
	payload JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'Finalized transcript turn payload', 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Creation time' DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_wework_transcript_turn_sequence UNIQUE (transcript_db_id, sequence), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_wework_transcript_turn_identity UNIQUE (transcript_db_id, turn_id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Hot finalized turns awaiting transcript archival'
CREATE INDEX idx_wework_transcript_turn_range ON wework_transcript_turns (transcript_db_id, sequence)

CREATE TABLE wework_transcripts (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Wework transcript primary key' AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Owner user ID' DEFAULT '0', 
	transcript_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Device-independent transcript identity' DEFAULT '', 
	parent_transcript_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Parent transcript identity; empty means this is a root transcript' DEFAULT '', 
	forked_at_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Parent sequence used to fork; 0 means no parent fork point' DEFAULT '0', 
	title VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Transcript display title' DEFAULT '', 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Transcript lifecycle state: active or archived' DEFAULT 'active', 
	current_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Latest synchronized hot turn sequence' DEFAULT '0', 
	archived_through_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Latest sequence moved to immutable archive storage' DEFAULT '0', 
	writer_client_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Current writer device ID; empty means no active writer' DEFAULT '', 
	writer_fencing_token BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Monotonic token fencing stale device writes' DEFAULT '0', 
	writer_lease_expires_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Writer lease expiry time; epoch means no active lease' DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000', 
	archived_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Archive time; epoch means the transcript is not archived' DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000', 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Creation time' DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), 
	updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Last update time' DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_wework_transcript_user_identity UNIQUE (user_id, transcript_id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Device-independent Wework transcript synchronization state'
CREATE INDEX idx_wework_transcript_parent ON wework_transcripts (user_id, parent_transcript_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_wework_transcript_user_updated ON wework_transcripts (user_id, updated_at)
